title: Data Engineer
description:
HM120: Data Engineer

Location: Titchfield or Newport – 2/3 days on site

Contract: 6 Months

Salary: Competitive Hourly Rate | Inside IR35

Overview:

First Military Recruitment are currently seeking a Data Engineer on behalf of one of our clients.

Our client encourages applications from ex-military personnel however all candidates will be given due consideration.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Write clear, well-tested Python code to build and maintain data pipelines, frameworks and systems.
  • Use Git, CI/CD and agreed engineering practices to deliver good-quality code.
  • Prepare, clean and transform data, checking quality and resolving inconsistencies.
  • Proactively investigate and resolve technical issues with colleagues.
  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical colleagues to understand requirements and deliver work.
  • Bring curiosity and innovation to your work, learning new tools, techniques and technologies through structured development pathways.
  • This role suits someone with Python development experience who delivers good-quality code, solves problems proactively and enjoys collaborating and learning.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience designing, coding, testing, correcting and documenting moderate-to-complex programs or scripts using agreed engineering standards and tools.
  • Practical experience with Python and SQL for data engineering, including cleaning, preparing and transforming data reproducibly at scale.
  • Experience using collaborative engineering practices and tools, including Git, code review, testing and documentation.
  • Ability to investigate, resolve and anticipate technical problems and implement preventive improvements.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and support constructive multidisciplinary discussions.
  • Ability to work independently, and contribute effectively as part of a team.
  • Active SC Clearance.
